sourceNotes: 三合一菜单栏与程序坞图标支持自由组合顶部指标、中部连接状态和底部读数
AI 用量菜单栏最多显示四个可选服务
菜单栏图标可按应用整理，并收起或展开选定应用，重启后保留选择
Wi-Fi 弹窗补充连接详情
自定义弹窗内容支持调整区块顺序
蓝牙音频新增设备整理与聆听模式切换
音频页支持滚动调节系统音量与输入音量，并可断开当前蓝牙音频输出
优化三合一图标的状态辨识与配色，并改善菜单栏图标折叠操作
修复 AI 用量服务选择无法记住、概览卡片显示服务不一致的问题，并兼容没有内置电池的设备

en: Customize the combined menu bar and Dock icon by choosing the top metric, middle connection status, and bottom reading.
Show up to four selectable AI providers in the menu bar.
Organize menu bar icons by app, then fold or reveal selected apps while keeping the selection after restart.
Show more details in the Wi-Fi popover.
Reorder sections in custom popover content.
Organize Bluetooth audio devices and switch their listening modes.
Scroll over the audio page sliders to adjust system or input volume, and disconnect the current Bluetooth audio output.
Improve state legibility and colors in the combined icon, and refine menu bar icon folding.
Fix AI usage provider selections not being remembered and overview cards showing a different provider; support devices without a built-in battery.
